checks: Authenticated startup uses a live catalog, no media downloads, and one route button with no empty cards
Pin/unpin is shared across Home/Audio, limited to three, and restored from the backend after reload
Route audio uses explicit backend sequence (including gaps), streams on tap, and indicates the playing row
Welcome Note opens multiple audios; Dinner and Toilet play directly without selection screens
Records opens the latest backend Drive URL and handles missing configuration
Connection loss interrupts streaming; API failure removes stale route data and retry recovers
Responsive route layout has no document overflow; only credentials/preferences persist; no browser runtime errors
